incumbent.text: LAı DIES Menu > LAiDIES ONLINE · CONNECTED TO THE REWIND ERA_ AI fluency, taught through the pop culture you never forgot. Made to click. Built to stick. LAiDIES helps women understand and use AI through stories, practical tools, games, music and community. Welcome to the Rewind Era—twenty years of pop culture, from dial-up to downloads (1990–2010)—and to SUNNYVAiLE, the learning town where Girl Power meets Machine Power. Be kind, rewind. Put the pop-culture encyclopedia in your head to work on what comes next. New in town? The latest episode Just running an errand? Explore the town THE LAiDIES METHOD Your brain kept the references. We put them to work. The plot explains it. The analogy unlocks it. Practice makes it click. The soundtrack makes it stick. Your brain has been saving Clueless, Carrie Bradshaw, “Wannabe,” dial-up tones, butterfly clips and roll-on glitter for years. At LAiDIES, that is not useless trivia. It is a head start. Every lesson unfolds in SUNNYVAiLE—a fictional town tuned to the Rewind Era (1990–2010), where sequential stories, accurate pop-culture analogies, practical activities and original songs work together to make AI easier to understand, use and remember. Listen to the trailer at the Visitor’s Centre → ▶ Hear the town anthem at KSVL How it all works WHY LAiDIES EXISTS ADA LOVELACE · KEEPER OF THE FIRST ALGORITHM Women have shaped computing from its earliest foundations and helped build the ideas, machines and methods that made modern AI possible. What it becomes next is being decided right now. Getting involved—learning it, using it, having opinions about it—is how we shape the future the way we shaped the past. That is why LAiDIES exists. And since we’re here anyway, we may as well have fun. In the famous words of Founding Mother Karen Spärck Jones: “Computing is too important to be left to men.” — KAREN SPÄRCK JONES · KEEPER OF THE INDEX So join LAiDIES and make sure women continue to light the way. Read their stories at the LUMINAiRY → Listen to Ep 04 · It Was Women All Along → COME FOR THE WHOLE STORY—OR ONE USEFUL THING What brought you to town today? You do not need to learn the town before you can use it. Take the Wednesday tour Released episodes, then the full eight-stop route through town Look something up Ask Miss Jeeves at the LIBRAiRY reference desk Fix a prompt or get guidance Bring it to the FAiRY Godmother Explore the town Six streets, every destination, and what you do there THE COMPLETE WEEKLY EXPERIENCE Your Wednesday in SUNNYVAiLE On Wednesdays we wear pink. Here, on Wednesdays we do AI—a new episode and its learning activities arrive every Wednesday, a little Mean Girls, a lot more useful. Episodes build on one another: start with the Trailer, then Episode 1. Returning readers, resume the newest episode—the eight-stop Full Route below is the whole experience, and the Express Route is there when you're short on time. WHERE YOU ARE IN THE SEASON Episode 04 · The Founding Mothers ▶ The Trailer 01 On Wednesdays We Do AI 02 Tell Me What You Want 03 Don’t Be Chutney on the Stand 04 The Founding Mothers PREVIOUSLY PUBLISHED ▶ New to LAiDIES? The Trailer introduces SUNNYVAiLE and the story. Then Episode 1 begins the season in order. Take the Express Route: episode → Study Pack → quiz. It is the same useful lesson in a shorter lap; no reward required. Start → COME FOR ONE THING. STAY IF YOU FEEL LIKE IT. Games and tools, open all day. Quick, useful activities around town—real help with work, a decision, or just a laugh with a blast from the past. No lesson required. Make the call PRIVATE HONOUR-SYSTEM GAME · 5–10 MIN Girl Talk Truth or dare for LAiDIES, with optional community-room inspiration. Resident Card required. Visit Delta LAi Nu SOURCE-CHECKED AI DEVELOPMENTS · CURRENT OR HONESTLY QUIET The NewsStand Four different desks for a qualified interruption, consequential briefing, durable synthesis or sourced argument—only when the evidence earns one. Check the NewsStand KSVL 99.9 The town’s original soundtrack. Hear creator-confirmed LAiDIES originals. KSVL holds only a file with a specific missing, broken, wrong or quality issue. Listen to KSVL → LANTERN HILL · THE LUMINAiRY Meet the women behind AI. Patron Saints light up the lessons. MAiVENS built computing and AI. Trailblazers are shaping it now. The decisions about AI are being made right now—in the products we use, the workplaces we run, the industries we built. LAiDIES exists so those decisions don't get made without us. Visit the LUMINAiRY → NEED ONE ANSWER—NOT A TOUR? Miss Jeeves will help you look it up. Search AI terms, models, companies, practical guides, sources, and previous episode lessons from one place. What are you trying to understand? Search the LIBRAiRY Popular: Hallucinations ChatGPT vs Claude Prompting GUIDED FIRST. EXPLORABLE ALWAYS. See everything in SUNNYVAiLE You never have to explore the town to use LAiDIES. But if you want to wander, every feature has an address — six streets of them, from MAiN to Willow Lane. The whole town, at a glance. Click any building to see what you can do there. MAiN Street Episodes, Study Packs, news, tarot, makeovers, happy hour, the Mall, and KSVL. Explore district → Civic Square Visitor Centre, Town Hall, Post Office, the LIBRAiRY and town orientation. Explore district → Schoolhouse Road Pop Quiz Wednesdays and the Book Fair at SUNNYVAiLE High. Explore district → Wisteria Lane Delta LAi Nu — the community rooms, Girl Talk, and your Closet. Explore district → Willow Lane The FAiRY Godmother's house. Wishes granted, prompts fixed, the kettle's on. Explore district → Lantern Hill The LUMINAiRY: Patron Saints, MAiVENS, and the Trailblazers shaping AI now. Explore district → The full town directory — every place, and what you do there SAVE, COLLECT AND CONTINUE Everything you learn—and earn—has somewhere to live. Your Resident Card is your SUNNYVAiLE town ID. Make it at MAiKEOVER on MAiN—it takes about two minutes. Until account and cross-device restoration finish their release checks, Card and Closet progress should be treated as saved on this device. Your Resident Card also opens the doors to Delta LAi Nu, SUNNYVAiLE’s sorority house, and gives you a local Closet inside. Its room prompts are open to browse; live discussion uses Hyvor’s sign-in when that service is available. Delta LAi Nu is also home to Girl Talk, our private honour-system SUNNYVAiLE spin on the classic ’90s truth-or-dare game. It’s considerably more fun than joining yet another professional networking group. Your Closet is where your SUNNYVAiLE life lives: a room of your own at Delta LAi Nu, with a page you can make yours and show off. Inside, you’ll find your progress, saved LIBRAiRY finds and the haul you collect as you explore: Charms — Hidden around town. Spot one and it snaps onto your bracelet. Puffies — Puffy stickers that mark your favourite Handbook pages. The Puffy Board keeps them together. Stickers — Selected quizzes and activities can add device-local keepsakes to your Card. They are not a verified account balance. Trading cards — Collect a pack with every episode. Duplicates are the point: trade them with other residents. Mail — Notes and gifts to your girls through the Post Office. Coming soon. Cher was right: “It does not say RSVP on the Statue of Liberty.” But we’d love yours. Become a SUNNYVAiLE resident—we’ll save you a Closet. Make my Resident Card → Already a resident? Open my Closet → JUST THE MAIL · THE POST OFFICE · CIVIC SQUARE Sign up for the Wednesday Postcard. Not ready to move to town? Get the week delivered instead: the episode, the Study Pack, the Pop Quiz and this week’s AI news—one letter, once a week, no Resident Card needed. A Resident Card does not silently subscribe you. Choose the Postcard separately if you want the weekly email. Sign up at the Post Office LAı DIES Girl power meets machine power. The Rewind Era shaped us. AI is shaping now. SUNNYVAiLE is where they meet. ← SUNNYVAILE HOME

In the famous words of Founding Mother Karen Spärck Jones:
— Karen Spärck Jones · Keeper of the Index
Listen to Ep 04 · It Was Women All Along →

Season One teaches the AI basics in 24 episodes, because we remember the glory days when a season had time for a proper plot, a questionable haircut and at least one inexplicable musical episode. Future seasons will continue the story—and take your AI fluency further.
Each episode pairs an unfamiliar AI concept with a film, television moment, character, lyric or gloriously specific Y2K reference your brain already understands.
Take the idea for a spin with a practical Try-On, then reinforce it with a printable guide, Pop Quiz and collectible teaching cards.
You’ll finish with something you can actually use—not just another tab you opened with excellent intentions and quietly abandoned three Tuesdays ago.
Twenty-nine creator-confirmed originals are ready to hear. The player checks the local catalogue and holds only a file with a specific missing, broken, wrong or quality issue.
Membership is free: no pledging, no rush week and no matching pink velour Juicy tracksuit required—although the outfit is highly encouraged… especially on Wednesdays.

allText: Made to click. Built to stick.
Your brain kept the references. We put them to work.
The plot explains it. The analogy unlocks it. Practice makes it click. The soundtrack makes it stick.
Listen to the trailer at the Visitor’s Centre →
Ada Lovelace · Keeper of the First Algorithm
Women have shaped computing from its earliest foundations and helped build the ideas, machines and methods that made modern AI possible.
In the famous words of Founding Mother Karen Spärck Jones:
— Karen Spärck Jones · Keeper of the Index
Listen to Ep 04 · It Was Women All Along →

Season One teaches the AI basics in 24 episodes, because we remember the glory days when a season had time for a proper plot, a questionable haircut and at least one inexplicable musical episode. Future seasons will continue the story—and take your AI fluency further.
Each episode pairs an unfamiliar AI concept with a film, television moment, character, lyric or gloriously specific Y2K reference your brain already understands.
Take the idea for a spin with a practical Try-On, then reinforce it with a printable guide, Pop Quiz and collectible teaching cards.
You’ll finish with something you can actually use—not just another tab you opened with excellent intentions and quietly abandoned three Tuesdays ago.
Twenty-nine creator-confirmed originals are ready to hear. The player checks the local catalogue and holds only a file with a specific missing, broken, wrong or quality issue.
Membership is free: no pledging, no rush week and no matching pink velour Juicy tracksuit required—although the outfit is highly encouraged… especially on Wednesdays.
